# Verified external PDFs

This directory is reserved for PDFs whose redistribution rights were checked for the individual version. It is **empty in v0.3** because outbound binary PDF retrieval was not available in the package-building environment. The metadata catalog and original PDF links remain available offline.

The optional fetch tool can fill this directory on an Internet-enabled workstation; its manifest will then record actual byte hashes. This is not a completed crawl.
